guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Google TPU v5p and SparseCore
guides.concept: 以矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片解析Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Google TPU v5p and SparseCore through matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識v5p TensorCore。資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 建立脈動矩陣與張量核的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識SparseCore embedding。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識張量佈局與分片。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識3D torus與ICI。mesh與torus具有不同的邊界連接與路徑；每chip頻寬不等於割頻寬。 建立3D 互連與拓撲的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對小型3D圖計算最大跳數及割邊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨slice集體傳輸。all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。 建立集體通訊與計算重疊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全串行與可重疊時間線。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Pod與單作業上限。Pod總規模、單工作上限與可預約slice不同；配置能力不等於所有作業均可取全Pod。 建立Pod 與工作切片的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將公開設備規模與支持的作業slice分開記錄。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify v5p tensorcore in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of systolic matrices and tensorcores, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sparsecore embeddings in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tensor layout and sharding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify 3d torus and ici in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Meshes/toruses differ in wraparound/routes; per-chip bandwidth differs from bisection bandwidth. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of 3d interconnects and topology, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute diameter and cut edges for small 3D graphs. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cross-slice collectives in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. All-reduce synchronizes updates/statistics; communication may overlap while retaining tail dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of collectives and overlap, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and overlapping timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify pod and per-job limits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v5p and SparseCore. Pod size, job limits and reservable slices differ; configurations do not give every job the whole Pod. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pods and job slices, focusing on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record device scale separately from supported job slices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：Pod總芯片數就是每個作業可直接預約的數量。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Every job can directly reserve the full Pod chip count.

related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片；Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦改以矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices; Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer centers on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照v5p TensorCore與v4 MXU張量shape，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare v5p tensorcore with v4 mxu tensor shapes and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from pod and per-job limits and propose an observation distinguishing matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices from matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects, including uncertainty.
